design_summary: The enemy roster and behavior systems for TUMU, spanning a procedurally animated quadruped predator (skeleton, IK, locomotion, attacks, precog pathfinding, scaling, weak spots) and a candy-themed enemy variety roster with density, coordination, and mini-bosses. All enemies are vector-rendered via _draw() with no sprites. The quadruped is the primary active development area and carries the most complex AI and physics work.

epics.title: Quadruped Monster — Procedurally Animated Predator
epics.summary: A physics-based procedurally animated quadruped that hunts players across multi-platform levels using foot-driven locomotion, 2-bone IK, head tracking, eight attack types, and pre-cognition platform pathfinding. Rendered entirely via _draw() with a 23-point skeleton and runtime config stack. Core build shipped across v0.9.8-v0.9.17 and refined through the v0.10.x line; thrash/IK/damage polish stories remain open.
